tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa snying po don gyi smin lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa snying po don gyi smin lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa snying po don gyi smin lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa snying po don gyi smin lam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang zil gnon khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de'ang dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pas las rab 'byams bsgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i slob dpon la/ ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub cing lha dang bla ma snying ltar 'dzin pa'i slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ rgyas par na lcags sdig khams lnga'i 'od mdangs las byung ba dbang chog mu tig phreng ba nyid grub na shin tu legs la/ yul dus kyi dbang gis rgyas po de tsam ma grub na/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su/ bum pa mgul chings nag po yi dwags kyi gos kyis dkris pa'i nang du srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang bar lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga ste bum rdzas so lnga blugs pa'i steng du/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang la a mṛ ta btab pa'i kha dar dmar gyis bkab cing me long gi nang du gtso bo'i bris sku dang gzung thag bcas pa bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du las bum/ phyag mtshan/ phur bu/ sman raka gtor ma/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ tshogs kyi yo byad la sogs pa bkod legs par bshams/ gzhan yang thod rnga/ rdor dril/ me tog la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'du bya/ slob dpon gyis phrin las snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung bsrangs pas bdag mdun bum thod rnams 'jug pa gcig par lha tshogs su gsal btab| bsnyen pa la 'bad/ las bum bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ nang bcud kyis gang ba'i dbus su nyi zla'i gdan la a yig dkar po gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs bcud bsdus bum chu la bstims/

ye shes kyi bdud rtsis sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ bum thod kyi lha lnga mchod cing bstod nas/ lha rnams bde stong byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu bas/ bum thod kyi bcud dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug blangs/ de rjes tshogs lhag yan grub par byas nas/ slob ma la khrus bya/ gral la bkod/ me tog bkram bsdus/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis gnam lcags kyi chos sde phyi skor lcags 'dra/ nang skor thog 'dra/ gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor ma bu cha lag dang bcas pa'i sngon byung gi lo rgyus dang*/ zab pa'i khyad par brgyud rim sogs ji ltar 'tsham pas spro ba bskyed la/ hoḥ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du// zil gnon phyag rgya chen po dang sbyor ba// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bskur dam pa bdag la bstsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ e ma hoḥ yang gsang phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'jug par 'dod pa legs na yang*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig tshogs// bsrung bar nus sam gsong por smros// zhes dris/ slob mas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag ni las dang skal par ldan// stobs chen zil gnon dbang mnos nas// dam tshig tshul bzhin nges par bsrung*// zhes gsol/ bla mas/ kye hoḥrigs kyi bu rnams nyon// dbang bskur dam pa thob pa yis// lha dang skal mnyam smin pa yis/ */ma bsgrub par yang grub pa sogs// phan yon brjod pa las 'das kyang*// dam tshig nyams na mnar med pa'i// rdo rje'i dmyal bar nges par 'tshed// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*// sbom po yan lag brgyad brgyad dang*// 'jam dpal khyad par dam tshig ni// nyi shu rtsa gnyis de las gzhan// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sogs| |dam tshig sdom pa ji snyed dang*// bsnyen sgrub las la sbyor ba sogs// dpal chen dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs// srog la bab kyang mi gtong bar// bsrung bar nus na dbang bskur sbyin//

zhes bsgrags/ slob mas/ rdo rje slob dpon 'dren pa'i gtso// zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// srung mar bcas pa bdag la dgongs// bla mas ji ltar bsgo ba yi// dam tshig sdom pa ji snyed dang*// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor phrin las sogs// srog la bab kyang mi gtang srung*// snying po'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol/ bla mas/ hoḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// dam tshig sdom pa gang gis rnam// bsrungs rnams lha srung dregs pa'i tshogs// ma bsgrub par yang nges 'grub 'gyur// ma bsrung lha dang srung ma yis// bka' chad drag po thog ltar 'bebs// las kyi gshin rje ma rungs pa// lcags sdig mgo dgur sprul nas kyang*// srog snying bla dbugs skad cig za// phyi ma rdo rje'i dmyal ba ru// bskal pa grangs med sdug bsngal myong*// de bas phan yon nyes pa rnams// dran par gyis la dam srungs shig / ces brjod/ slob mas/ gu ru ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan/ zhes bro bor/ bla mas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes mna'i btung ba sbyin/ slar/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo slob dpon dang*// yi dam zil gnon 'khor bcas la// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ slar/ hoḥ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// sems can thams cad bde thob cing*| |sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol bar smon// de phyir phyag rgya zil gnon gyi// go 'phang bdag gis thob byas nas// sems can kun don bsgrub par bya'o// zhes gsum/ de nas/ e ma hoḥ bla ma dkyil 'khor lhar bcas pas// bdag cag smin cing grol ba'i phyir// rdo rje khro chen ye shes kyi// sprin tshogs bdag la dbab du gsol// gsum/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong*// zhes pa nas/ ma srin thams cad dbang du bsdu//

zhes pa'i bar/ phrin las snying po bsdus pa ltar lha gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang*/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdakar ser dmar ljang spros pas/ 'og min dag pa chos dbyings bsam brjod dang bral ba'i pho brang nas 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar spyan drangs slob ma la thim pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsam zhing*| sbyar ba'i spos bsregs rol mo dang bcas pas/ a+ye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza dzñā na badz+ra satwa ma hā kro dha rā dza ā we sha ya ā kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes ye shes pa dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ me tog thogs la/ dregs pa'i dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// rdo rje rin chen me tog phreng*// gus pas 'bul gyi rigs nges pa'i// dngos grub mtshan ma bstan du gsol| |ya mān+ta ka pū dza puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dor/ rigs nges par lung bstan/ bla mas/ e ma zil gnon dregs par bcas// ye shes gzungs kyi me tog phreng*// de ring cod pan dam pa bcings| |sems dpa' stobs chen 'di zung zhig /pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog slob ma'i mgor bzhag go// dngos gzhi dbang bskur la bum gsang sher tshig bzhi las/ dang po'i don du/ hoḥ sprul pa sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du// zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// lus la smin byed rdo rje'i skur// grub mdzad dbang bskur deng stsol cig / gsum/ gtso bo'i bris sku mgor bzhag | oṃ/ chos dbyings mtha' bral drag po'i zhing khams nas// snying rjes rab khros zil gnon stobs kyi lha// 'khor bcas sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya'i dbang bskur sbyin// sku yi dbang mchog lus la rdzogs par shog

/a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes bskur/ slar/ oṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi shigs sku dang ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje sku yi bkra shis shog /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed slob ma phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i dpral par 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gsum pa'i lte bar oṃ dang*/ rtsibs la sku'i sngags yig 'bru bcu gsum dang*/ phyi rol tu a+yai ring rnams dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar āḥdang*/ 'dab mar gsung gi sngags 'bru bcu gnyis/ phyi rol tu a+yai ring rnams dmar po/ snying khar khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa rnam par gdengs pa'i lte ba dang dbus rwa la hūm̐/ yas mas rwa brgyad la thugs kyi sngags 'bru brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu a+yai ring rnams nag po// lte bar rin po che cha bcu dgu pa ser po'i dbus su swā dang*/ a+ye thung 'bru bcu dgu pa'i phyir a+yai ring rnams ser po/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgya gram rwa gdengs pa ljang gu'i lte bar hā dang*/ dbus rwa bzhi la a+ye dun 'bru bzhi pa'i phyir a+yai ring rnams ljang gu gsal btab la/ āḥ zil gnon thugs dam bskul dang phrin las sgrub// rab 'byams sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// bskal me ltar 'bar gnam lcags thog ji bzhin// sbyin gyi gsung dbang ngag la rdzogs par shog /a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rak+sha'i phreng ba gtad cing*/ sngags rnams rjes zlos byed pa'i tshe/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi sngags phreng rnams las sngags phreng gnyis pa re re thog bab pa ltar skad cig la spros te slob ma'i sngags phreng rnams la thim par bsam zhing*/ sku gsung thugs sngags a+ye thung*/ e dun/ a+yai ring rnams rjes zlos bya/

slar slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// brjod/ bla mas/ āḥ dpal ldan rdo rje'i gsung 'chang ba// rdo rje mi shigs gsung dang ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje gsung gi bkra shis shog / ces brjod/ phyag mtshan rnams gtad la/ hūm̐ */ ngar 'dzin 'chi bdag sgrol byed 'khor lo 'bar| |ral gri rdo rje be con gtun shing dang*// sdigs mdzub phyag mtshan rtags kyi dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi dbang mchog sems la rdzogs par shog /a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi shigs thugs dang ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje thugs kyi bkra shis shog / sman raka gtor ma lag tu gtad cing*/ swā/ lha rnams mchod cing dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas// rtsa brgyad sman dang 'ben chen sman chen po// dam rdzas gtor mar bcas pa'i dbang mchog ni// deng 'dir sbyin gyi yon tan lhun rdzogs shog /a+ye ka he dun gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ zhes gtad cing cung zad re rol/ swā/ dpal ldan rdo rje yon tan 'chang*// rdo rje mi shigs yon tan ldan| |deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// yon tan rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / phur bu lag gnyis su gtad cing liṅga'i snying khar bsgril zhing 'debs su bcug la/ hā/ nyon mongs ngar 'dzin dgra bgegs ru tra rnams// bsgral nas dag pa'i go 'phang thob bya'i phyir// rdo rje phur bu drag po las kyi mtshon// de ring sbyin gyi phrin las kun 'grub shog /a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā/ zhes btab/ hā/ dpal ldan rdo rje phrin las 'chang*// rdo rje mi shigs phrin las ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// phrin las lhun grub bkra shis shog / ces bskur| mtha' rten chu dbang ni/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma/ rdo rje'i khro bo dang khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal| |de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor pa'i lhas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod cing me tog gi char 'bebs/ sems ma rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs su gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs shing glu dang gar mdzad/ rol mo'i sgra sgrog /khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ khro mo rnams kyis phyogs bcu srung*/ rgyal ba rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis| |skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur bas// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis deng*// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐// zhes bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbu la thod pa'i pho brang lnga'i nang du/ mtshog mar bu+ud+dha he ru ka yab yum/ dpral bar badz+ra he ru ka yab yum| rna ltag g.yas su rat+na he ru ka yab yum/ ltag par pad+ma he ru ka yab yum/ rna ltag g.yon du karma he ru ka yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul bas dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje'i slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams su bstim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor/ de'i tshe slob ma lha yab yum du gsal ba 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bum dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes brda sprad/ des sgyu 'phrul dra ba phyag rgya gsal rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus rtsa'i dri ma dag /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ lus sprul skur smin par byas/ sku rdo rje phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas pa yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ gnyis pa'i don du/ hoḥ kun+da nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du// dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// ngag la smin byed rdo rje'i gsung*// grub mdzad dbang bskur deng stsol cig | gsum/ slob dpon 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon dang rang snang gi yum be tā lī'i kha sbyor gsum gyi sbyor bas gnas bzhir byang sems phab pa rdo rje pad+ma'i lam brgyud mkha' gsang du 'dres pa mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i kha dog lta bu mtheb srin gyis phab pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi la bsres pa thogs te/ e ma hoḥ thabs chen yab dang shes rab yum// lhan cig sbyar ba nyi zla 'bar// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mchog /snod bcud dag pas dbang bskur ro// a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes thod pa mgrin par gtad/ slar yang*/ hoḥ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig / ces dang*/ sngags gong ma bzla zhing*// thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin/ slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de ltar byang chub sems lce thog tu bstsal ba myangs pas zhu bde lhan skyes thig le gsum gyi yi ge mngon du byas pa ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes brda sprad/ des kun rdzob byang sems dkar dmar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag rlung gi dri ma dag /stong srog sngags kyi rim pa rnams bzla ba la dbang*/ ngag longs skur smin par byas/ gsung rdo rje rlung sngags dbyer med ā di kā di'i ngo bor dag pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas pa yin no| | zhes go ba bskyed/ gsum pa'i don/ hoḥ bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor na// mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// yid la smin byed rdo rje'i thugs// grub mdzad dbang bskur deng stsol cig / gsum/ slob dpon zil gnon du gsal ba'i sbyor yum las sbyor yum gnyis pa spros/ slob ma zil gnon yab rkyang du gsal ba'i brla g.yon pa'i steng nas 'khyud cing sbyar bas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam/ slob dpon gyis shes rab ma'i tsaka li gtad/ e ma hoḥngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'dod chags kyis ni 'dod chags sbyong*// phyag rgya gsang ba'i sgrub bde mo| |sbyin gyi thabs ldan longs spyod cig /a+ye ka he dun pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ slar me long bstan la/ e ma hoḥ snang ba med la snang ba mchog /stong pa'i dbyings su snang ba shar// snang stong dbyer med rig pa'i mchog /bsten na spros bral bde stong 'bar// zhes sngags gong ma brjod/ de ltar snang stong zung 'jug gi rig ma la 'khyud sbyor snyoms 'jug gi rol pa bstan cing byang sems 'pho med du bcings pas/

lus thams cad bde bas gang zhing bde ba'i ngo bo stong pa nyid du shar ba stong pa'i rang rtsal bde bar 'bar ste/ bde stong zung 'jug rjes chags dpe'i ye shes mngon du byas pa ni sher dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes brda sprad/ des gsang ba bha ga chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas e'i dkyil 'khor chen por shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid thig le'i dri ma dag /snang stong shes rig gi 'khyud sbyor bde stong nyams su blang ba la dbang*/ yid chos skur smin par byas/ thugs rdo rje bde stong zag med lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas pa yin no// bzhi pa'i don du/ hoḥ 'gyur med bde chen dkyil 'khor na// rig pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// sgo gsum smin byed rdo rje gsum// grub mdzad dbang bskur deng stsol cig / gsum/ lcags sdig lus po mthing nag gru gsum las byung ba/ rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzing gi le'u bcu par/ e nyid stong pa chos 'byung zhing*// ma skyes skye 'gag med pa la// rgyu rkyen sngags las ma skyes par// rol pa chen po'i sku ru gsal// zhes pa'i don yin la/ de'ang e nyid ces pa chos thams cad kyi ngo bo spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba rang bzhin stong pa chen po ste/ de ni chos 'byung zhes pa 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi chos dang chos can thams cad ngo bo stong pa de las mdangs cir yang 'char zhing 'byung ba zil gnon lha skur gdod nas grub pa/ de dag kyang gzhan logs shig nas btsal du med pa rang gi sems nyid spros bral bsam brjod las 'das pa 'di nyid yin la/ zil gnon bskyed sgom yang sngar med gsar bskrun min par rig bzo dang bral ba 'di ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa rang bzhin lhun grub/ skye 'gag med pa la zhes de lta bu'i rang sems lhar gdod nas grub pa de ni slar bcos ma'i rkyen gyis skye ba dang 'gag pa 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid med pa des na rgyu 'di las lha bskyed ces pa dang*/

rkyen 'di lta bus bskyed ces pa'i sngags tshig gi spros bcas las ma skyes par lhun grub rang gsal du rdzogs pa yin la/ kun rdzob tu rtsab rtsub ni don dam par med par thag chod pas na/ rol pa chen po'i sku ru gsal/ zhes pas/ rang sems skye 'gag gnas gsum mtshan 'dzin rtag chad kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ stong pa la stong par rol/ gsal ba la gsal bar rol/ 'dzin med la 'dzin med du rol/ chos nyid la chos nyid du rol pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i tshig don mang yang*/ rol pa chen po'i sku zhes rang sems lha yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa de la der 'dzin med par rab bab rang gshis su zil gnon gyi skur rdzogs pa/ lha dang rang sems tha dad du 'dzin pa'i mchog dman gyi rtog pas ma bslad pa/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zhes pa don dam spros bral gyi lha yin pas ngo shes par byos shig /de ltar bcos min du rtogs pa la lta ba rgyab kyi lha zhes sam/ 'bros pa'i ri zhes bya/ de'i gsal snang dang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya ba la gnyen po stobs kyi lha zhes sam/ rten pa'i mkhar zhes bya/ de'i rang rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba dregs pa can bran du bkol ba ni mngags pa las kyi lha zhes sam/ drangs pa'i dmag ces bya/ de'i grogs rten 'brel rdzas kyi rim pa phur thun mtshon cha sogs la ni brdeg pa'i mtshon zhes bya ste/ de bzhi la gal po che bzhi dang ldan zhes tha snyad du mdzad do// gzhan yang gshin rje'i gshed dang phyag rgya zil gnon sogs kyi mtshan sbyar bshad ngo sprod kyang zla gsang gi rgyud rnams su mang du gsungs te/ ji skad du/ gshin ni skye ba med pa ste// rje ni 'gag pa med pa'i don// gshed ces bya ba mtha' gnyis bral// de phyir gshin rje tshe bdag yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'ang go zhing rig par bya'o// zhes tshig tsam gyi dbang bskur ro// de ltar tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad pas spros bral lhan skyes zung 'jug don gyi ye shes mngon sum du nyams su myong ba ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no//

zhes brda sprad/ des don dam blo 'das dbyings rig zung 'jug 'gyur ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum der 'dzin gyi dri ma dag /phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgom pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i chos sku'i ngo bo nyid kyi skur smin par byas/ ye shes rdo rje spros bral zab zhi gnyis med 'od gsal don dam chen po'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas pa yin no| | zhes go ba sbyin/ de nas lugs 'di'i khyad chos sbyor sgrol dang tshe dang baṃ gyi dbang bzhi gsungs pa las/ sbyor dbang ni gsum pa dang*/ sgrol dbang ni phrin las kyi dbang gi dus su song la/ 'dir rnal 'byor pa'i bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje tshe'i dbang ni/ hoḥ bkra shis dngos grub bum pa ru// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas// rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas// 'chi med brtan pa'i dbang thob shog /a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza ā yur+dzñān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur la/ 'dir tshe gtor sogs logs su mi dgos te zil gnon nyid tshe'i bdag po yin pas gtso bum gyis dbang bskur zhing bum chu dang thod chang sogs sbyin/ baṃ chen dbang ni/ e ma hoḥ sngags 'chang brtul zhugs sngags byin bskyed pa dang*// lha dang srung ma brtan pa'i dam tshig mchog /baṃ chen rol la rtog med mnyam par rol// bde chen mnyam nyid rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza ma hā ti ra a dhi pa ti sid+dhi hoḥ zhes baṃ chen lag tu gtad cing khar sbyin rak+ta blud do// de ltar rdo rje tshe'i dbang bskur bas dus min 'chi ba las bzlog cing tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub/ baṃ chen gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas gtsang dme gnyis 'dzin rtog pa 'joms shing lha dang dregs pa 'du zhing mnyes la dam rdzas dngos grub chen po thob par byed pa'o//

zhes go ba sbyin/ baṃ chen gsang ba'i dbang 'di la brten nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi dbang bskur baṃ chen gsang ba'i dbang zhes sgos ming spyi la 'dogs pa'i tha snyad kyang gnubs chen po sogs kyis mdzad do// de ltar dbang bskur bas sngar bsgrags pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par rnams dang*/ gtso bor bla ma dang lha srog la bab kyang mi gtang*/ sku'i dam tshig bskyed rim lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral/ gsung gi dam tshig ngag drag po'i sngags bzla ba dang mi 'bral/ thugs kyi dam tshig sems gdod nas lhar grub pa chos nyid zab mo'i lta ba'i gdeng dang mi 'bral/ spyod lam thams cad du sems can gyi don las mi 'gal bar spyod pa rnams ni khyad par dgos pa'i dam tshig lnga yin pas/ srog la bab kyang mi gtang snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsdus la btang*/ bla mas bskul nas shis brjod kyi bar phrin las snying po bsdus pa'i mjug rdzogs par bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// dbang chog mu tig phreng ba thob na dbang 'di nyid ma thob kyang chad pa'i skyon mi 'byung la/ 'di nyid thob kyang mu tig phreng ba ma thob na 'dis de'i go mi chod la/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs ni byar rung ba yin no// de ltar gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i chos sde chen po'i dbang bskur mdor bsdus 'di'ang*/ dbang chog mu tig phreng ba ma grub pa'i tshe lta bur 'khyer bde lag len du bya ba'i slad du 'on rin chen brag gi gdan sa ba mnga' ris dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang lam 'di 'dzin pa shākya'i sras po dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ lcags khams yos bu lo snron gyis nya ba'i dmar po'i bzang po gsum pa rje btsun dam pa chos kyi rgyal po zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya 'dul ba'i slad du gshegs pa'i dus khyad par can la/

'bri chos phyug gi klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par sbyar ba 'di ni mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i gshin rje tshar gcod pa'i gshed chen nyid du gor ma chag par gyur cig gu// //maṅga laṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa aṅkār ā gats+tsha//
